title: Existential theories of henselian valued fields under a formal smoothness assumption
summary: We study existential theories of henselian valued fields of positive characteristic with parameters from a trivially valued subfield. Compared to previous work, we relax perfectness and separability assumptions, and instead work with the weaker algebraic hypothesis of formal smoothness over the parameter field, which we discuss in detail in our setting.
